name: Kredo
tagline: Authentication that calls out counterfeits before your customers do.
positioning: Kredo is the authentication layer for luxury resale platforms—forensic imaging plus a verdict API so every handbag, watch, and sneaker ships with proof.

hero.sub: Stop paying three ex-boutique staff to squint at zippers. Kredo returns a pass/fail verdict with reasoning in under 90 seconds—at warehouse scale.

features.title: Verdicts, not vibes
features.description: Your team gets a confidence score, side-by-side reference stitching, and the exact microdetail that failed—so QA stops arguing about it in Slack.

features.title: Sub-90-second calls
features.description: Upload twelve photos, get a decision with reasoning before the seller finishes their coffee. Batch endpoints handle warehouse-scale intake.

features.title: Provenance that survives audits
features.description: Every verdict is hashed, timestamped, and exportable. When a chargeback dispute lands, you hand over a file instead of a shrug.

features.title: Superfake-grade models
features.description: Trained on the seams, serials, and hardware that fool humans. Retrained weekly as the fakes get smarter—because they will.

features.title: Fits your intake flow
features.description: Drop the widget into your consignment app or pipe raw images through the API. No forklift migration, no six-month consultants.

features.title: See your fake rate
features.description: Dashboards break down rejections by brand, seller, and region—so you can quietly cut off the vendor flooding you with counterfeit Cartier.

testimonials.quote: We were paying three ex-boutique authenticators to squint at zippers. Kredo caught two superfakes on day one that they'd have waved straight through.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman

testimonials.quote: Our chargeback rate on watches dropped 40% once every listing shipped with a Kredo verdict attached. Legal actually smiled at me.
testimonials.name: Marcus Whitlock

testimonials.quote: Onboarded in a weekend, not a quarter. The batch API cleared our 6,000-bag backlog before the leadership offsite even ended.
testimonials.name: Danielle Osei
